confirmatory_boundary: This protocol does not modify the frozen v3 code-feature classifier, estimand, or primary outcomes.
proxy_assumption: For this exploratory analysis, a commit detected as agent-written from the normalized writing style and content of its commit message is treated as agent-authored code: all eligible code lines introduced by that commit are attributed to an agent. Message authorship and code authorship are not independently verified.

eligibility.revision_walk: all non-merge commits reachable from the pinned cutoff
eligibility.eligible_code: non-binary added lines in source-code files; generated, vendored, lock, fixture, and minified paths are excluded

normalization.purpose: prevent direct provenance leakage into the writing-style score
removed: recognized provenance and sign-off trailer lines

signals.definition: normalized body contains at least 80 words
normalized body has at least four nonblank lines and at least two paragraphs
normalized body has at least three bullet or numbered-list lines
normalized body has at least four terminally punctuated sentences and at least half of nonblank prose lines end in sentence punctuation
normalized body explicitly reports running or passing tests, checks, lint, type checking, or a build using the frozen lexical patterns
body word count is strictly above the repository's pre-adoption 90th percentile
paragraph plus bullet plus sentence count is strictly above the repository's pre-adoption 90th percentile

decision_rule.score: one point per true signal; no learned weights or fitted parameters
decision_rule.classification: agent-detected when score is greater than or equal to the threshold

repository_baseline.window_end: strictly before the datable adoption point
repository_baseline.insufficient_baseline_behavior: record baseline_status=unavailable and assign no local-outlier points

attribution.unit: commit and eligible added source-code line
attribution.rule: attribute every eligible added source-code line in an agent-detected commit to agent code
reported_estimands: agent-attributed share of eligible added source-code lines

validation.positive_reference: maintainer-attested agent repositories and explicit provenance commits
validation.negative_reference: commits made while a repository-local AI contribution ban was in force
validation.label_use: post hoc validation only; labels are not used to choose features, weights, or thresholds
report: precision and recall where reference labels exist
